== Template:Item/SkillBook ==

Template for displaying skill book tooltips. Skill books teach combat abilities to characters.

=== Parameters ===

{| class="wikitable"
! Parameter !! Required !! Description
|-
| '''image''' || Yes || Item icon image filename
|-
| '''name''' || Yes || Skill book name
|-
| '''value''' || No || Item value in gold, or "Unsellable"
|-
| '''arcanist_level''' || No || Required level for Arcanist class
|-
| '''druid_level''' || No || Required level for Druid class
|-
| '''paladin_level''' || No || Required level for Paladin class
|-
| '''reaver_level''' || No || Required level for Reaver class
|-
| '''stormcaller_level''' || No || Required level for Stormcaller class
|-
| '''duelist_level''' || No || Required level for Windblade class
|-
| '''skill_type''' || No || Skill type (e.g., Combat, Utility)
|-
| '''skill_desc''' || No || Skill description
|-
| '''simplayers_autolearn''' || No || Set to "false" if SimPlayers don't auto-learn
|}

=== Example ===

'''Code:'''
<pre>
{{Item/SkillBook
|image=Skill Book: Kick.png
|name=Skill Book: Kick
|duelist_level=3
|paladin_level=1
|stormcaller_level=5
|skill_type=Attack
|skill_desc=Kick an enemy. Interrupts target's spells.
}}
</pre>

'''Result:'''

{{Item/SkillBook
|image=Skill Book: Kick.png
|name=Skill Book: Kick
|duelist_level=3
|paladin_level=1
|stormcaller_level=5
|skill_type=Attack
|skill_desc=Kick an enemy. Interrupts target's spells.
}}
